candidates.author: Arve_Vang1
candidates.body: Thanks Arve. The Gmail diagnostic 56949320 already showed DP102 as 0 or 100, but Homey's official valve_position capability is 0-1 (SDK 12.2), so the tile stayed empty. I scaled DP102 reports to 0-1, write a percent set to DP101, keep a status refresh read-only (no DP1 open/close), expose DP27 power-off behaviour (close / open / memory) as a setting, and skip app-level button flows on this driver. The fix is in master commit SHA_PENDING_MASTER_PUSH and will be in the Test build after 9.0.1636. FrankEver _TZE200_1n2zev06 / TS0601.
